title: SieveIVF

items: Threshold-Aware IVF Execution for Large-Scale Training Data Deduplication
Hu et al., arXiv v1, August 4, 2026
Adaptive query work with partition-major execution

note: 读数必须区分相同 index/search 参数与相同 recall。后者是关键生产比较。

title: A known threshold creates a stopping signal

items: Dedup candidate retrieval seeks neighbors above application similarity threshold τ.
Fixed nprobe gives easy and difficult queries the same partition budget.
Observed qualifying neighbors often concentrate early in centroid-distance order.

note: 这是候选边检索阶段。后续图构建、保留代表样本及训练影响均不在检索加速数字内。

title: Consecutive threshold-empty partitions stop a query

items: Preserve the IVF centroid-distance partition order.
Reset stale to zero after any qualifying local result. Increment stale after an empty result.
Stop at W consecutive threshold-empty partitions or the nprobe cap.

note: Empty 指没有满足 τ 的返回候选，而不是 partition 没有数据。规则是近似停止启发式，可能漏掉后面的命中。

title: Continuous batching preserves partition locality

items: Each query tracks its next rank, stale count, and accumulated results.
Ready query–partition items group by destination IVF partition.
Partition-local microbatches reuse search machinery as query state advances.

note: 逐 query 串行搜索容易破坏 SIMD、缓存与并行度。动态 regrouping 是系统贡献的重要部分。第 4.2 节。

title: Lookahead exposes committed work

items: Initially every query must search ranks 1 through min(W, nprobe).
A hit at rank j extends the stop line to at least min(j + W, nprobe).
Only committed prefix ranks enter the queue. Completion order does not alter the final stop line.

note: Lookahead 的等价性相对于同一停止规则成立，不是相对于穷举所有 partitions 的精确召回保证。第 4.3 节。

title: Integration keeps the existing index format

items: The authors implement the executor in Lance.
It reuses on-disk IVF layout, within-partition search, and final bounded top-k merge.
Microbatches contain up to 16K ready items for one partition.

note: 论文称已实现，不代表专用 public code 已发布。本次未核实专用仓库，不能链接 Lance 主仓库冒充该实现。第 5 节。

title: Experimental workloads
note: 100K held-out queries。默认 cosine IVF_RQ7、exact centroid assignment、nprobe=90、k=10、W=8。第 6.1 节。

title: Same-parameter headline results
note: 第三行来自 measured fixed-probe settings 的等召回插值。不能把前两行当成相同质量下 4–8 倍。第 6.2 节。

title: Execution ablations explain the speedup

items: Serial threshold traversal reduces work but fragments partition calls.
Continuous batching restores grouped execution and supplies most of the throughput gain.
Lookahead increases microbatch occupancy and helps low-concurrency workloads.

note: 第 6.3 节平均 microbatch 从 24–51 增到 162–209。实际收益依赖 batch、缓存、阈值与负载分布。

title: Operating envelope and recall limits

items: Exact centroid assignment is a stated precondition for the stopping signal.
Smaller W skips more work but can lose important late neighbors.
Filtered top-k recall differs from complete threshold-edge recall needed by some dedup graphs.

note: 不能从 top-10 pooled metric 推断所有重复边都完整，也不能从漏边率直接推导训练质量不变。

title: Data infrastructure application proposal

items: Inference: pass similarity predicates into physical execution rather than filtering only at the end.
Proposed application: version τ, W, nprobe, embeddings, and index builds as a dedup recipe.
Proposed application: audit missed edges by domain and duplicate-cluster tail size.

note: 需要把召回预算、图决策与删除策略串成可复查闭环。这里是应用建议。

title: Reproduction and acceptance gates

items: Use a small public embedding corpus with exact normalized ground truth.
Compare fixed probing across a tuned frontier against W sweeps at equal recall.
Measure wall time, partition searches, microbatch occupancy, and downstream retained-set quality.

note: 未执行研究代码或 GPU 作业。没有 verified dedicated public implementation 是复现的实际缺口。
